title: Paloma and the Inheritance
author: Orsen Almeida
blurb: Isandro Marchetti, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
